tasks.title: Banner & Nmap Scripts
tasks.description: The banner usually reveals the mail server software and version. Nmap's smtp-commands script also shows which commands (VRFY, EXPN, RCPT) are supported.

tasks.title: VRFY / EXPN / RCPT TO Enumeration
tasks.description: Use smtp-user-enum to brute-force valid usernames if VRFY is enabled, or automate the RCPT TO method when it's disabled but the server still leaks user validity.

tasks.title: Test for Open Relay
tasks.description: Attempt to relay mail through the server to an external address. If it accepts, you can spoof mail from arbitrary senders for phishing pretexts.

tasks.title: Send Phishing Email
tasks.description: Send a crafted email (with an attachment/payload) to a discovered valid internal user.
